subject: POC: prompt-log capture playbook, success criteria & owners
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@novalumen.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial prompt/log samples and success criteria (post-call)

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — super helpful. A quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get you the data for the POC: 

Summary of what we want to evaluate
- Accuracy of historical triage suggestions on clinical intake notes (primary).
- Latency under a simulated burst (90th percentile target: < 350ms per response).
- Token-cost / throughput tradeoff with quantized variants (cost target: <$0.0009/token equivalent).

Success criteria (internal)
- Top-1 match rate >= 78% on our labeled sample (we'll provide labels).
- False positive rate for high-risk tags < 5%.
- End-to-end latency SLA met for 95% of requests under our test harness.

Data we can deliver by next Tuesday (attachments):
- prompt_log_sample.csv — 1,200 anonymized prompts with metadata columns (timestamp, patient_region, prompt_text, system_context).
- POC_SuccessCriteria_v1.xlsx — internal scoring rubrics and label schema.

Constraints and compliance notes
- Some logs may contain PHI; we will anonymize but need to validate the handling steps. We will require a data processing addendum and confirmation of log deletion policy after the trial. Jake (cc'd) will be on legal for redlines.

Asks from Redwood
- A short ingestion spec: preferred S3 path + required IAM role or secure transfer method.
- Confirmation on where the evaluation runs (hosted vs dedicated vs private). If hosted, we need the DPA addendum.
- A named engineering contact and an ops owner for the trial window.

Next steps
- We can send the first batch (prompt_log_sample.csv + labels) by Tue 2028-07-19 if you confirm ingest details and owner contacts by end of day Tue.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Data Science, NovaLumen Health

--
Attachment(s): prompt_log_sample.csv (attachment stub), POC_SuccessCriteria_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@novalumen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial prompt/log samples and success criteria (post-call)

Sarah — thanks for the clear recap and the sample. High level: we can run the eval on hosted infrastructure for an initial trial (fastest time-to-insight) but given PHI considerations we should confirm whether you prefer Redwood Private (VPC) for the later stage. 

Proposed short POC plan (2 weeks):
- Day 0–2: Secure transfer + data validation (Redwood infra + legal DPA). Owner: Ben Carter (eng).
- Day 3–6: Indexing + initial eval run on 1.2k sample (automated metrics + small heldout manual review). Owner: Monica Patel (product ops).
- Day 7–10: Quality review + prompt/candidate tuning; run burst-latency tests on synthetic harness. Owner: Ben (infra).
- Day 11–14: Final report, handoff, and recommendation (go/no-go). Owner: Grace (CS lead).

Immediate asks from us (please):
1) Confirm whether the sample we received is already anonymized per your compliance team. If not, can you share the redaction steps you will run?
2) Provide an S3 path or arrange transfer (we support temporary presigned uploads or direct S3 transfer). We will provide an ingest IAM role if you prefer.
3) Confirm legal lead (Jake is fine) and whether NovaLumen needs an extra DPA for trial PHI handling.

Technical notes
- We'll run the first pass on a medium-sized Llama-family variant that we pre-qualify for cost/latency. If you want an enterprise-only option (Private), we'll scope the baseline performance and provide an MSA addendum.

I copied the proposed owners above — Ben and Monica will be your day-to-day contacts. If that works, we'll schedule a 30-minute handoff call for Wed (UTC morning) to confirm the ingestion details.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment(s): None

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@novalumen.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — ingestion details and security notes

Sarah — quick technical follow-up and checklist so your engineers have a clear handoff. Thanks for sending the sample. 

Ingest options (pick one):
A) Presigned S3 upload to our secure bucket (preferred) — we will give you a short-lived IAM policy scoped to the prefix. Requires: S3 path, principal email for logs.
B) Direct transfer to your S3 with a cross-account role we assume — requires account id + role ARN.
C) Encrypted upload to a private VPC endpoint if you choose Redwood Private (we'll provide instructions).

Minimum file schema we need (match columns in prompt_log_sample.csv):
- id, timestamp_iso, prompt_text, user_id_hash, region, original_channel, label (optional), anonymization_flag

Data handling commitments (trial):
- We will only persist ingest artifacts for 30 days for the trial and then run a secure deletion followed by a certificate of deletion.
- For PHI: if any content is flagged post-ingest, we will quarantine that batch and work with your compliance team. We will not use trial logs for model training unless explicitly agreed.

Owners and contacts
- Ingest & infra: Ben Carter — ben.carter@redwood.ai (primary)
- Eval & product ops: Monica Patel — monica.patel@redwood.ai (primary)
- Legal & contracts: Grace O'Connor — grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Next steps for your engineers
1) Confirm preferred ingest option (A/B/C) and which S3 path to use by EOD Thu 2028-07-19.
2) If option A: we'll send presigned urls and a short curl example.
3) Once we receive the files we will run a validation pass and share the initial metric sheet within 72 hours.

Thanks — happy to jump on the handoff call or do a terminal session with your SREs if you want it ironed out live.

Ben
Ben Carter
Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
